newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 6.26 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 6.26 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at Wednesday's 15.0 trillion lire 37-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 6.26 percent, compared with 6.90 percent at the previous repo tender on June 24, the Bank said.
The Bank said 11.319 trillion lire had been taken up in the tender, not the full 15.0 trillion.
The average rate was 6.69 percent against 6.93 percent at the last repurchase pact for 5.0 trillion lire and 21 days.
The pact covers purchases today or Thursday and the securities are for resale on August 1. The Bank said it received 31 bids all of which were met in full.
